Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You turn the bottle toward the light and recognize a familiar cloud in the liquid.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One accessible potion or mixture; 10 minutes
Duration
The result applies when the stated activity is complete; information and earned progress persist.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Weak: learn broad purpose. Standard: learn its use and effects. Strong: also reveal contamination or a harmful additive. Does not consume the mixture.
